description: Agent Control: submit a system design that splits work between a model and code: each decision or computation with its kind (arithmetic, threshold, eligibility, limit, rounding, conversion, date, formatting, extraction, classification and others), who makes it (model, code, or model checked by code), the check applied and what the output is used for, plus the deterministic components available. The signed report names every decision the model makes that code should compute, every model output used for money, a customer or a record with no deterministic check, and the smallest reassignment for each. Verdict model_computes, unchecked_output or deterministic_core. POST /api/deterministic-core-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-control-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-control/.
